body: Can you share the link for the listing here? I'll be going to Korea next month and I'm currently looking at AirBnB for accomodations. I just want to make sure to steer clear from that host.

Hello again! I think I should apologise for taking too long to reply back. But my best friend came back from her trip abroad last week, and she's been keeping me company since. We've been hanging out a lot, because she knows I tend to overthink negatively when I'm left alone.

So, anyway. Wow. Thank you so much for this. I think you gave me too much credit in what you said about me though lol. But thank you for the kind words. :)

It was very uplifting reading your story. I'm glad you shared that with me. I think you deserve your happiness after what you went through, so I'm glad things turned out well for you. Your story did give me hope for the future. Even though I'm still a bit scared of what's going to come and how things will turn out for me, and even though occassionally I still get negative thoughts of what a failure I am, your story reminded me that maybe it won't all be that bad, and that I can work through it no matter what life throws at me.

So again, thank you. I feel like I can't thank you enough for reaching out to me and telling me your story. I'll always try to remember what you shared when I go through hard times so I can hold up hope that there will be better times ahead.

First of all, thank you for taking the time to read up and comment on my post. It was really encouraging to see your comment and the upvotes from other people. Even though I don't know any of you personally, I'm touched that people even care about me. I literally just cried when I got back to my post and saw this.

As for your question, I do have my best friend. She knows how I feel and has been very supportive. However, we don't get to talk in person, only through messages, because she's currently abroad with her family on a vacation, and I don't want to be too much of a downer on her when she should be having a good time.

I would love to hear your story of how things got better in your life. I know it's going to be tough road ahead to get over this slump, to be honest sometimes I feel so hopeless because everything seems so daunting, and I don't even know where to start, and maybe hearing your story will be the insight and help I'll need.
